text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s03","problem":"Text renders about 1px off and a bit heavier or lighter than the real screen: the heatmap shows red over the 'My Apps', 'Explore', 'Recommended', 'Trending', 'Photoedit', 'Edit your images' and card title text. In the mock, 'Recommended' and 'Trending' sit about 1px higher.","fix":"Shift the headings 'Recommended' (real baseline ~y=90) and 'Trending' (~y=424) down 1px. Match the font weight to the real screen (semi-bold, 20px headings). Check that the card titles 'Photoedit' and 'Anima' are the same size and weight (about 20px semi-bold)."},{"element_id":"s03","problem":"A stray ghost text fragment shows through in the mock between the Trending header and the cards (near x=140-190, y=440). It also shows at the right edge near y=730, where the real screen has none.","fix":"Remove the leftover text, or clip it beneath the cards and the Create app button. Nothing should show at y=435-450 or at x=380-411, y=725-740."},{"element_id":"s03","problem":"The 'Create app' pill is slightly off: the mock draws its edge and shadow differently, so the heatmap shows a red outline. The bottom of the real card at y~700 also has a darker fade.","fix":"Make the pill exactly x=16 to 395, y=706 to 742, with a white fill and a fully rounded radius. Remove any extra border or shadow. Match the dark gradient at the bottom of the trending cards."},{"element_id":"s03","problem":"The gradients on the Recommended card and the Trending cards differ in tone (mock pink and red are slightly more saturated). The Anima card's green and blue and the Stories card's dark preview also differ, so the heatmap is red over the whole card.","fix":"Re-sample the card gradient colors from the real screen. Use a softer pink (#F58BD0 top-left) fading to red (#F0455F right) and dark at the bottom. Also make the Stories preview's inner text and thumbnails match the real one's position and size."},{"element_id":"s03","problem":"The bottom nav labels and icons (Chat, Services, Create) show red, so they are slightly offset or differ in weight.","fix":"Set the labels to 15px medium, centered under the icons at y~813. Align the Services icon to the real position, with the sparkle at the upper right. Keep the Create active circle at #2B2F8F."}],"summary":"The mock is already very close: all 18 tagged elements are within 4px, all taps work, and there are no contract errors. Remaining differences are small text offsets and weight, gradient tones on the cards, a stray ghost text fragment near the Trending cards, and fine detail in the bottom pill and nav. This round should clean up the stray text and tune the text metrics and card colors."}
